data.body: [P2] Avoid comparing service completion time with the SDK clock. As the new case-25 clock-skew regression recognizes, execution-view external completion timestamps are not calibrated to the observation attempt's SDK clock. A service timestamp ahead of that clock makes this assertion and the observation span's reciprocal `after` fail despite correct completion history and an Invocation-2 link. Remove both cross-clock comparisons from execution case 26, retain the history ordering and invocation-link assertions, and add a skewed-timestamp regression analogous to case 25.
